description: The owner's climate table for the continental water pass (rivers and lakes design 4.1). Breakpoint lists are [temperature C, mm/yr], ascending, linear between breakpoints and clamped at the ends. Runoff is Turc-Pike: P - P / (1 + (P/PET)^n)^(1/n), or P where PET is 0. A lake's net evaporation is max(0, E(T) - P). Ice nodes run off ice_melt_runoff_mm. biome_climate gives each zonal biome a typical [precipitation mm/yr, temperature C], used past 120 ka and where the Beyer et al. 2020 grids have no value. Read by timefly_core's tests, the game shell (Task 4) and the Python reference pass (Task 11).
